appendix_b_items.notes: Host Enclave PLATFORM-ALPHA holds the authorization. This classifier is technology below the system level and is incorporated via Assess Only. Version bump does not expand the authorization boundary.
Promotion pipeline identity `mlops-promote` is the only principal that can overwrite catalog tags. Weights are not world-readable. Break-glass is ISSM-approved.
Catalog pull, tag promote, and serving-config change events ship to the host SIEM. Retention follows the host ATO package.
Serving image digest pinned in the release manifest. Unused debug ports remain closed. Change ticket bound to this bump.
No new flows. Training remains on the isolated build enclave; serving stays on the existing inference VLAN.
sha256 digest recorded in hash-manifest.txt. Catalog tag is immutable.
Serving-stack CycloneDX exists. Model-artifact SBOM is a gap pending generator enablement.
Host ConMon job `clf-runtime` covers availability, CPU/GPU saturation, and 5xx rate. Model treated as a versioned pipeline artifact.
Generic IR playbook exists. Model-specific extraction/evasion tabletop is scheduled, not yet executed.
Runtime and accelerator suppliers are inherited from the host SCRM package. No new third-party weights.
doc-route-clf 1.2.0 → 1.3.0. Artifact hash in pack identity and hash-manifest.txt.
Training set is the internal document-routing corpus v3. Data card and dataset hash are in the catalog. No raw training data in this pack.
Dataset pinned. Intake review exists. Canary/holdout against label-flip is documented as a residual gap.
Holdout F1 0.91 against proposed F1 >= 0.88. AO has not yet accepted the threshold. See eval-holdout-v13.txt.
Proposed PSI <= 0.2 and F1 >= 0.88. Marked not-negotiated. Re-assess trigger: two consecutive weekly jobs below F1 0.88.
No adversarial/evasion suite was run for 1.3.0. Residual risk recorded for AO review.
Inference API is internal-only with rate limits, but extraction/inversion tests were not performed.
Preprocessor and decision threshold pinned in the serving config manifest for 1.3.0.
Stored in the host model catalog, not a share drive.
Document-routing corpus is business records without PII by data-card assertion. N/A with documented no-PII statement.
Responses are class labels plus confidence only. No free-text generation. Additional output-filter monitor not yet wired.
This pack is the Assess-Only body of evidence for the bump. It is not an ATO. Host ISSM will attach the zip to the authorization package if the AO accepts residual risk.

thresholds.reauth_trigger_notes: Two consecutive weekly holdout jobs below F1 0.88, or a serving-stack change, triggers re-assess of this pack.

residual_risk.statement: Primary residual risk is unevaluated evasion and extraction against an internal-only classifier API. SBOM for the model artifact is incomplete. Thresholds are proposed, not AO-accepted. This pack does not grant authorization.
mitigations: Keep inference on the existing internal VLAN with rate limits.
Schedule evasion/extraction tests before expanding the interface.
Complete model-artifact SBOM on the next bump.
